classes.name: ShapeUpgrade
classes.summary: This package provides tools for splitting and converting shapes by some criteria. It provides modifications of the kind when one topological object can be converted or split in to several ones. In particular this package contains high level API classes which perform: converting geometry of shapes up to given continuity, splitting revolutions by U to segments less than given value, converting to beziers, splitting closed faces.

staticMethods.name: C0BSplineToSequenceOfC1BSplineCurve
staticMethods.comment:
Unifies same domain faces and edges of specified shape.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `seqBS`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

staticMethods.name: C0BSplineToSequenceOfC1BSplineCurve
staticMethods.comment:
Converts C0 B-Spline curve into sequence of C1 B-Spline curves. This method splits B-Spline at the knots with multiplicities equal to degree, i.e. unlike method `GeomConvert::C0BSplineToArrayOfC1BSplineCurve` this one does not use any tolerance and therefore does not change the geometry of B-Spline. Returns True if C0 B-Spline was successfully split, else returns False (if BS is C1 B-Spline).
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `seqBS`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

classes.name: ShapeUpgrade_FaceDivide
classes.summary:
Divides a Face (both edges in the wires, by splitting curves and pcurves, and the face itself, by splitting supporting surface) according to splitting criteria.
- The domain of the face to divide is defined by the PCurves of the wires on the Face.
- all the PCurves are supposed to be defined (in the parametric space of the supporting surface).
The result is available after the call to the Build method. It is a Shell containing all the resulting Faces.
All the modifications made during splitting are recorded in the external context ({@link ShapeBuild_ReShape | `ShapeBuild_ReShape`}).

instanceMethods.comment: Initialize by a Face.

It is updated according to modifications made. The optional argument <theArea> is used to initialize the tool for splitting surface in the case of splitting into N parts where N is user-defined.

instanceMethods.comment: Performs splitting of surface and computes the shell from source face. The optional argument <theArea> is used to initialize the tool for splitting surface in the case of splitting into N parts where N is user-defined.

Builds a new shape from a former one, by calling Sewing from {@link BRepBuilderAPI | `BRepBuilderAPI`}. Rebuilt solids are oriented to be "not infinite".

classes.name: ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain
classes.summary:
This tool tries to unify faces and edges of the shape which lie on the same geometry. Faces/edges are considering as 'same-domain' if a group of neighbouring faces/edges are lying on coincident surfaces/curves.
In this case these faces/edges can be unified into one face/edge. {@link ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain | `ShapeUpgrade_UnifySameDomain`} is initialized by a shape and the next optional parameters: UnifyFaces - tries to unify all possible faces UnifyEdges - tries to unify all possible edges ConcatBSplines - if this flag is set to true then all neighbouring edges, which lay on BSpline or Bezier curves with C1 continuity on their common vertices, will be merged into one common edge.
The input shape can be of any type containing faces or edges - compsolid, solid, shell, wire, compound of any kind of shapes. The algorithm preserves the structure of compsolids, solids, shells and wires. E.g., if two shells have a common edge and the faces sharing this edge lie on the same surface the algorithm will not unify these faces, otherwise the structure of shells would be broken. However, if such faces belong to different compounds of faces they will be unified.
The output result of the tool is the unified shape.
All the modifications of initial shape are recorded during unifying. Methods History are intended to:
- set a place holder for the history of modifications of sub-shapes of the initial shape;
- get the collected history. The algorithm provides a place holder for the history and collects the history by default. To avoid collecting of the history the place holder should be set to null handle.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (aShape: TopoDS_Shape, UnifyEdges?: boolean, UnifyFaces?: boolean, ConcatBSplines?: boolean)
constructors.comment: Constructor defining input shape and necessary flags. It does not perform unification.

instanceMethods.name: Initialize
instanceMethods.signature: (aShape: TopoDS_Shape, UnifyEdges?: boolean, UnifyFaces?: boolean, ConcatBSplines?: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes with a shape and necessary flags. It does not perform unification. If you intend to nullify the History place holder do it after initialization.

instanceMethods.name: AllowInternalEdges
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the flag defining whether it is allowed to create internal edges inside merged faces in the case of non-manifold topology. Without this flag merging through multi connected edge is forbidden. Default value is false.

instanceMethods.name: KeepShape
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the shape for avoid merging of the faces/edges. This shape can be vertex or edge. If the shape is a vertex it forbids merging of connected edges. If the shape is a edge it forbids merging of connected faces. This method can be called several times to keep several shapes.

instanceMethods.name: KeepShapes
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the map of shapes for avoid merging of the faces/edges. It allows passing a ready to use map instead of calling many times the method KeepShape.

instanceMethods.name: SetSafeInputMode
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the flag defining the behavior of the algorithm regarding modification of input shape. If this flag is equal to True then the input (original) shape can't be modified during modification process. Default value is true.

instanceMethods.name: SetLinearTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the linear tolerance. It plays the role of chord error when taking decision about merging of shapes. Default value is `Precision::Confusion()`.

instanceMethods.name: SetAngularTolerance
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the angular tolerance. If two shapes form a connection angle greater than this value they will not be merged. Default value is `Precision::Angular()`.

instanceMethods.name: Build
instanceMethods.comment: Performs unification and builds the resulting shape.

instanceMethods.name: Shape
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the resulting shape.

instanceMethods.name: History
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the history of the processed shapes.

classes.name: ShapeUpgrade_WireDivide
classes.summary: Divides edges in the wire lying on the face or free wires or free edges with a criterion. Splits 3D curve and pcurve(s) of the edge on the face. Other pcurves which may be associated with the edge are simply copied. If 3D curve is split then pcurve on the face is split as well, and vice-versa. Input shape is not modified. The modifications made are recorded in external context ({@link ShapeBuild_ReShape | `ShapeBuild_ReShape`}). This tool is applied to all edges before splitting them in order to keep sharing.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes by wire and face.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment: Initializes by wire and surface.

instanceMethods.name: Load
instanceMethods.comment: Loads working wire.

instanceMethods.name: Load
instanceMethods.comment: Creates wire of one edge and calls Load for wire.

instanceMethods.name: SetFace
instanceMethods.comment: Sets supporting surface by face.

instanceMethods.name: SetSurface
instanceMethods.comment: Sets supporting surface.

instanceMethods.name: SetSurface
instanceMethods.comment: Sets supporting surface with location.

instanceMethods.name: Perform
instanceMethods.comment: Computes the resulting wire by splitting all the edges according to splitting criteria. All the modifications made are recorded in context ({@link ShapeBuild_ReShape | `ShapeBuild_ReShape`}). This tool is applied to all edges before splitting them in order to keep sharings. If no supporting face or surface is defined, only 3d splitting criteria are used.

instanceMethods.name: Wire
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the resulting Wire (equal to initial one if not done or Null if not loaded).

instanceMethods.name: Status
instanceMethods.comment: Queries status of last call to `Perform()` OK - no edges were split, wire left untouched DONE1 - some edges were split FAIL1 - some edges have no 3d curve (skipped) FAIL2 - some edges have no pcurve (skipped).
